lines.cap: A judge fined everyone in his courtroom. Here's why.
lines.say: A judge fined everyone in his courtroom. Here's why.

lines.cap: The story goes: New York, the 1930s, in the middle of the Depression. The mayor himself is sitting as judge.
lines.say: The story goes: New York, the 1930s, in the middle of the Depression. The mayor himself is sitting as judge.

lines.cap: An old man is brought in. He stole a loaf of bread.
lines.say: An old man is brought in. He stole a loaf of bread.

lines.cap: His family had no money, and his grandchildren were going hungry.
lines.say: His family had no money, and his grandchildren were going hungry.

lines.cap: The judge says: the law makes no exceptions. I fine you ten dollars.
lines.say: The judge says: the law makes no exceptions. I fine you ten dollars.

lines.cap: Then he takes ten dollars from his own pocket, and pays the fine himself.
lines.say: Then he takes ten dollars from his own pocket, and pays the fine himself.

lines.cap: And he fines everyone in the courtroom fifty cents, for living in a city where a man has to steal bread to feed his family.
lines.say: And he fines everyone in the courtroom fifty cents, for living in a city where a man has to steal bread to feed his family.

lines.cap: The hat goes round. The old man walks out with forty-seven dollars and fifty cents.
lines.say: The hat goes round. The old man walks out with forty-seven dollars and fifty cents.

lines.cap: Nobody knows if every detail is true. But it's the kind of judge people still talk about.
lines.say: Nobody knows if every detail is true. But it's the kind of judge people still talk about.
